content:
Apple has recently raised the prices of several products, but the company is now promoting two ways for consumers to save money when buying new hardware: a sales tax holiday and a back-to-school promotion.

Sales tax holidays and back-to-school promotions are the two ways Apple currently offers to save money on new hardware purchases.

If you're looking to buy a new Apple product, Apple is now promoting two ways to save money on Apple.com.

This summer, several U.S. states are holding sales tax holidays on designated dates. Alabama's promotion ended last weekend, but nine other states still remain, including:

  • Arkansas: August 1-2
  • Florida: July 20 to August 20
  • Massachusetts: August 8-9
  • Missouri: August 7-9
  • New Mexico: July 31 to August 2
  • South Carolina: August 7-9
  • Tennessee: July 31 to August 2
  • Virginia: August 7-9
  • West Virginia: July 31 to August 3

The specific terms of these holidays vary; you can find more details here. Being able to buy a new Apple product tax-free can save quite a bit of money, especially in states with higher caps.

Apple is also running back-to-school promotions on select Mac and iPad models.

From now through August 27, eligible buyers (including students and educators) who purchase a new Mac or iPad will receive a gift card of up to $150.

The MacBook Pro is the only product eligible for the full $150 Apple gift card. If you buy a MacBook Air, iPad Pro, or iPad Air, you'll receive a $100 gift card.

Depending on which product you're interested in, you may find better deals elsewhere. For example, Amazon's current Apple deals include:

  • AirTag 2 four-pack: $89 (originally $99)
  • AirPods Pro 3: $199 (originally $249)
  • Apple Watch Series 11: $299 (originally $399)
  • AirPods Max 2: $449 (originally $549)

Where do you most often find deals on Apple products? Feel free to share in the comments.
